Fleet.title: Vonco Partners bilan zamonaviy avtomobilda ishlang
Fleet.description: Biz yo'lni biz kabi sevadigan haydovchilarni qidirmoqdamiz. Bizda har qanday didga mos 100 ga yaqin mashina bor: ishonchli **Skoda Fabia**dan tortib, qulay **Toyota Camry**, **Lexus** va hatto **Tesla**gacha. Mashinalarning aksariyati zamonaviy gibridlar, bu esa yoqilg'iga kamroq sarflab, ko'proq daromad topish imkonini beradi.
Fleet.incomeNote: Biz bilan tushumning **55% gacha** qismini olishingiz mumkin. Hammasi shaffof va halol.
Fleet.flexibility: Mashinani yolg'iz ijaraga oling yoki xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sherik bilan bo'lishing. Ish grafigini sizga moslashtiramiz — talabalar yoki qo'shimcha daromad uchun ideal tanlov.

cards.rentDesc: Ham ish, ham shaxsiy yumushlar uchun mashina oling. Yashirin yurish (probeg) cheklovlari yo'q.
cards.shiftDesc: O'zingizga qulay vaqtda ishlang: kunduzi, kechasi yoki faqat dam olish kunlari. O'zingizga o'zingiz xo'jayinsiz.
cards.doubleDesc: Mashinani do'stingiz bilan bo'lishib, navbat bilan ishlashingiz mumkin. Bu ikkalangiz uchun ham foydali.

footerBox.title: Jamoamizga qo'shilishni xohlaysizmi?
footerBox.text: Biz Krakov va Zakopaneda mashina beramiz. Agar boshqa shahardan bo'lsangiz — muammo yo'q, biz sizga shaxsiy mashinangizda haydovchi bo'lishga yordam beramiz va Vonco-ning qulay to'lov tizimiga ulaymiz.

FleetInfo.description2: Avtoparkimizda turli toifadagi 100 ga yaqin mashina bor: Toyota Prius, Corolla, Camry, Lexus, Tesla, Skoda Fabia va Superb.

car.title: Ish uchun avtomobil
car.desc: Mashina sizning ixtiyoringizda — ish va shaxsiy safarlar uchun, depozitsiz va yurish cheklovisiz.
car.fullDetails: Siz taksi litsenziyasiga ega, to'liq tayyor mashina olasiz. Servis, moy almashtirish va ta'mirlash xarajatlarini biz o'z bo'ynimizga olamiz. Mashina 24/7 sizda qoladi — undan ham ish, ham shaxsiy ehtiyojlaringiz uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.

schedule.desc: O'zingizga qulay vaqtda ishlang: kunduzi, kechasi yoki faqat dam olish kunlari. O'zingizga o'zingiz xo'jayinsiz.
schedule.fullDetails: Bizda majburiy smenalar yoki rejalar yo'q. Ishga chiqish vaqtini o'zingiz tanlaysiz. Bu taksi ishini o'qish yoki oilaviy yumushlar bilan birga olib borish imkonini beradi. Daromadingiz faqat sizning faolligingizga bog'liq.

shared.desc: Mashinani muddatli to'lov (vikup) asosida sotib olish va keyinchalik shaxsiy mashinangizda ishlash imkoniyati.
shared.fullDetails: Mashina egasi bo'lishni xohlovchilar uchun dastur. Siz mashinani keyinchalik sotib olish huquqi bilan ijaraga olasiz. Ijara haqining bir qismi mashina tannarxiga o'tadi. Yashirin to'lovlarsiz shaffof shartlar.

WorkPage.title: Start work with Vonco Partners
WorkPage.subtitle: We help drivers in Poland quickly start earning with Uber, Bolt and FreeNow, with or without their own car.
WorkPage.aboutText: Vonco Partners is an official fleet partner. We provide cars, settlement support, and help with everyday driver operations in Krakow, Katowice, Gdansk and nearby cities.

benefits.earningsText: Clear settlement model, understandable commission and predictable payments without hidden fees.
benefits.scheduleText: Work full-time or part-time. You choose your pace and shifts depending on your goals.
benefits.supportText: We support drivers with onboarding, app setup, and daily questions related to the job.
benefits.legalText: Official cooperation model and assistance with required formalities and documents.
